Arthritis.description: Joint inflammation causing pain, stiffness, and swelling — early diagnosis helps manage long-term joint health.

Asthma.description: A chronic respiratory condition causing breathlessness and wheezing — needs ongoing management and monitoring.

Back Pain.description: Lower or upper back discomfort from strain, posture, or spinal issues — orthopaedic evaluation helps identify the cause.

Blurred Vision.description: Reduced visual sharpness that can signal refractive errors or an underlying eye condition needing evaluation.

Body Ache.description: Persistent muscle or joint pain can signal strain, infection, or an underlying condition worth checking.

Breast Cancer.description: Abnormal growth in breast tissue — early screening and diagnosis significantly improve treatment outcomes.

Chronic Kidney Disease.description: Gradual loss of kidney function over time — regular monitoring helps slow progression and manage complications.

Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (C.description: A progressive lung disease causing breathing difficulty — long-term pulmonary care improves quality of life.

Coronary Artery Disease.description: Narrowing of the arteries supplying the heart — cardiac evaluation helps prevent serious complications.

Diabetes.description: A chronic condition affecting blood sugar regulation — regular monitoring and endocrine care keep it managed.

Epilepsy.description: A neurological condition causing recurrent seizures — ongoing neurological care helps manage and reduce episodes.

Fever.description: A common sign of infection or illness — get it evaluated to find the underlying cause and the right treatment.

Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD).description: Chronic acid reflux affecting the digestive tract — gastroenterology care helps manage symptoms and prevent damage.

Heart Failure.description: A condition where the heart struggles to pump blood effectively — cardiac monitoring supports long-term management.

Herniated Disc.description: A spinal condition causing back or nerve pain — orthopaedic evaluation helps determine the right treatment path.

Hypertension (High Blood Pressure).description: Persistently elevated blood pressure that raises the risk of heart and kidney complications if untreated.

Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).description: A chronic digestive disorder causing abdominal discomfort — gastroenterology care helps manage symptoms.

Kidney Stones.description: Hard mineral deposits in the kidneys causing pain — urology care helps with treatment and prevention.

Lung Cancer.description: Abnormal cell growth in the lungs — early screening and pulmonology care improve treatment outcomes.

Migraine.description: Recurring, often severe headaches — neurological evaluation helps identify triggers and manage episodes.

PCOD/PCOS.description: A hormonal disorder affecting the ovaries — gynecological care helps manage symptoms and long-term health.

Parkinson's Disease.description: A progressive neurological disorder affecting movement — ongoing neurological care supports long-term management.

Rheumatoid Arthritis.description: An autoimmune condition causing joint pain and inflammation — rheumatology care helps manage flare-ups.

Sore Throat.description: Throat irritation or pain, often from infection or allergies — see a specialist if it lingers beyond a few days.

Stroke.description: A medical emergency caused by disrupted blood flow to the brain — timely care is critical for recovery.

Thyroid Disorders.description: Conditions affecting thyroid hormone levels — endocrinology care helps restore metabolic balance.

Tuberculosis (TB).description: A bacterial infection primarily affecting the lungs — early diagnosis and treatment prevent complications.

Ulcerative Colitis.description: A chronic inflammatory bowel condition — gastroenterology care helps manage flare-ups and symptoms.

Viral Hepatitis.description: Liver inflammation caused by viral infection — early diagnosis and care help protect long-term liver health.
